informal_statement: The angular type-(C) weighted perimeter is \(2(\pi-(1-\lambda)\beta)/\tan\beta\).
reason: CMVBallDefinitions.lean:33-36: The formal expression 2*(pi-(1-lam)*beta)/tan(beta) agrees exactly with the translation. The inner-arc deficit from a circle of radius cot(beta) gives the same weighted perimeter as CMV p.35.
